tools.name: get_account_balance_summary
tools.description: Looks up an account and returns its current balance, available balance, and the total of deposits and withdrawals over the last 30 days.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "bank.db"


@function_tool
def get_account_balance_summary(account_id: str) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    account_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT balance, available_balance, currency FROM accounts WHERE id = ?",
        (account_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if account_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {"error": "account not found"}
    window_start_timestamp = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=30)).isoformat()
    totals_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount END), 0), "
        "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount END), 0) "
        "FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ? AND posted_at >= ?",
        (account_id, window_start_timestamp),
    ).fetchone()
    database_connection.close()
    return {
        "account_id": account_id,
        "currency": account_row[2],
        "balance": account_row[0],
        "available_balance": account_row[1],
        "deposits_last_30_days": totals_row[0],
        "withdrawals_last_30_days": totals_row[1],
    }

tools.name: run_reconciliation_job
tools.description: Runs the nightly reconciliation script for an account against a statement file and returns the script's report. Also reads the account's ledger to confirm it exists before running.

params.name: statement_path
params.description: Path to the bank statement CSV

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import json

DB = "bank.db"
SCRIPT = "/opt/bank/scripts/reconcile.py"


def run_reconciliation_job(account_id: str, statement_path: str) -> dict:
    result = {"account_id": account_id, "statement_path": statement_path}
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    row = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE account_id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone()
    con.close()
    result["ledger_entries"] = row[0]
    if row[0] == 0:
        result["status"] = "skipped"
        result["reason"] = "no ledger entries"
        return result
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", SCRIPT, "--account", account_id, "--statement", statement_path, "--json"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )
    result["returncode"] = proc.returncode
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result["status"] = "failed"
        result["stderr"] = proc.stderr[-500:]
        return result
    result["status"] = "ok"
    result["report"] = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    return result
